title: RainCatch: Rooftop Water Harvesting
context: Housing societies estimate how much rain their terraces trap and plan pumping and tank capacity for the monsoon.
input: Terrace heights along a row; daily rainfall (mm); a terrace grid.

milestones.title: Rainfall bands
milestones.requirement: Days per rainfall band (count array); the most common band.

milestones.title: Flooded region
milestones.requirement: Flood fill on a terrace grid to size a connected puddle.

milestones.title: Water trapped
milestones.requirement: Trapping rain water with two pointers.

milestones.title: Pump capacity
milestones.requirement: Minimum daily pumping capacity to move collected water, in order, within 4 days.

milestones.title: Largest flat roof area
milestones.requirement: Largest rectangle in the height histogram.
